notes.title: Demo Update - UI changes and Weather effects
notes.notes:
The UI for drawing and playing cards has been reworked to look more like conventional cards. Cards have had several visual updates to make them more compact and consistent.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45601395/4d7547e202b4dba8920c8a64e9a5ffd50f0e0242.jpg"]

The day/night cycle is now much more apparent with more dramatic lighting and shadows.
[olist]
The draw phase happens during the early morning when it is dark and foggy

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45601395/89a71f1393d1351cd6012dca3af9e921b86bd9a1.png"]

The player phase happens later in the morning when its a bit brighter.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45601395/1daa766cd7247eb408f3618dc00d2450746668df.jpg"]

The labor phase happens at midday. The fog has cleared and the sun is at its brightest. The four resource locations get their individual weather events.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45601395/a30ace1c7de871ee43a1ce67028420985b429168.jpg"]

By peril phase the sun has nearly set.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45601395/2ea0b056257d33db711955bb764906ea90c70935.jpg"]
[/olist]
